title: Exploring the Impact of Tunable Agents in Sequential Social Dilemmas
reasoning: This paper is a technical study in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), investigating how to tune agents to be either cooperative or competitive in a gridworld environment (Wolfpack) using multi-objective techniques. While it discusses 'cooperation' and 'social dilemmas,' these are treated as game-theoretic and reward-optimization problems rather than benchmarks or evaluations of religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
